file_name: MN-60048 - Ingenia - Peet - Flagstone JV - third-party questionnaire template - Oct 2026.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Ingenia and Peet and/or any business controlled or managed by BNI are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Ingenia, Peet and/or any business controlled or managed by BNI.
